decision.reasoning_trace: The decision was based on the high rating and number of reviews of the products. The consideration set was chosen by selecting products with a high rating (above 4.5) and a large number of reviews (over 500). The final choice was made by selecting the product with the highest rating and the most reviews, which is the JBL Go 3 Portable Waterproof Wireless IP67 Dustproof Outdoor Bluetooth Speaker (Blue).
